title: GFG: Peak Element
description: An element is called a peak element if its value is not smaller than the value of its adjacent elements (if they exist). Given an array `arr`, return any valid index of a peak element.
constraints:
1 <= len(arr) <= 10^5
• Time: O(log N) or O(N) | Space: O(1)
explanation: Linear scan checks peak condition (>= neighbors) returning first valid index in O(N) time.
